title: Northgate Protect Accident Plans: Weighting of Claim Payouts in a Cancellation Refund
content:
**Rule.** On a Northgate Protect Accident-tier cancellation refund, a payout weighting is added to the used share, which is one less the unused coverage days divided by the coverage days, by the payout share, that is the repair, replacement, reimbursement and food-loss settlements booked on the plan divided by the limit of liability registered on the plan, zero when no limit is registered:

| Payout share | Weighting added to the used share |
|---|---|
| 0.25 (25 percent) or more | The heavy payout weight, 0.5, times the payout share |
| Above zero but below 0.25 | The light payout weight, 0.25, times the payout share |
| Zero | Nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Registered limit of liability | Settlements booked on the plan | Payout share | Weighting added |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1,000.00 | $300.00 | 0.30 | 0.15 |
| $1,000.00 | $250.00 | 0.25 | 0.125 |
| $1,000.00 | $100.00 | 0.10 | 0.025 |
| $1,000.00 | None | 0 | Nothing |
| None registered | Any | 0 | Nothing |

The settlements counted are every repair, replacement, reimbursement and food-loss settlement on the plan's ledger; the registered limit is the total of the plan's limit-of-liability registrations.
